15. (Currently Amended) A method of selecting an edge server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising the steps of: accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; __adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on a second server computer, wherein the information is added by a media request broker and includes load balancing data specific to identifying server capacity and availability__; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator __by the media request broker in response to a media request containing the unique signature__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 15, __wherein the second server computer is a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the method further comprising the steps of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an HTTP request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this HTTP request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, and providing the information to the media request broker in response to the selection of the hyperlink__.

17. (Original) The method of claim 15, the media request broker receiving the information from a plurality of server computers and analyzing the information to identify a preferred server computer.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, __the media request broker selecting the first server computer based on the analyzed information and server load metrics__.
